MephistoSkullMissileUnyieldingPower.name: Unyielding Power
MephistoSkullMissileUnyieldingPower.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Skull Missile. Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, increase Skull Missile's damage by 100. Reward: After hitting 40 Heroes, Skull Missile gains an additional charge.

MephistoLightningNovaFuriousSpark.name: Furious Spark
MephistoLightningNovaFuriousSpark.description: Every 3rd hit from Lightning Nova against the same target deals 65 bonus damage and grants Mephisto 2 Mana.

MephistoShadeOfMephistoMaliciousIntent.name: Malicious Intent
MephistoShadeOfMephistoMaliciousIntent.description: Shade of Mephisto grants 25% Spell Power while active and for 2.5 seconds after ending. If Mephisto hits enemy Heroes at least 18 times with his Basic Abilities while Shade of Mephisto is active, then increase the duration of the Spell Power bonus to 10 seconds after it ends.

MephistoSkullMissileHatefulMending.name: Hateful Mending
MephistoSkullMissileHatefulMending.description: Skull Missile grants 10 Mana and heals Mephisto for 70% of the damage it deals to Heroes.

MephistoLightningNovaStaticBarrier.name: Static Barrier
MephistoLightningNovaStaticBarrier.description: At the end of its duration, Lightning Nova grants Mephisto a Shield equal to 40% of the damage it dealt to Heroes. Lasts 5 seconds.

MephistoSpite.name: Spite
MephistoSpite.description: Increase Regeneration Globe healing duration by 100%. Every tick of Regeneration Globe healing activates Lord of Hatred, reducing Basic Ability cooldowns by 1 second.

MephistoShadeOfMephistoGhastlyArmor.name: Ghastly Armor
MephistoShadeOfMephistoGhastlyArmor.description: Shade of Mephisto grants 25 Armor while active and for 2.5 seconds after it ends.

MephistoShadeOfMephistoFrostStorm.name: Frost Storm
MephistoShadeOfMephistoFrostStorm.description: While Shade of Mephisto is active, enemies who are hit by Lightning Nova are Slowed by 15% for 1 second and the Slow from Skull Missile is increased to 50%.

MephistoShadeOfMephistoTrickery.name: Trickery
MephistoShadeOfMephistoTrickery.description: Shade of Mephisto grants 20% Movement Speed while active and for 2.5 seconds after it ends. If Mephisto hits enemy Heroes at least 18 times with his Basic Abilities while Shade of Mephisto is active, then reset the cooldown of Shade of Mephisto.

MephistoConsumeSouls.name: Consume Souls
MephistoConsumeSouls.description: Channel for 2.5 seconds, revealing all enemy Heroes. After the Channel completes, all enemy Heroes take 357 damage and are Slowed by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

MephistoDuranceOfHate.name: Durance of Hate
MephistoDuranceOfHate.description: After 1 second, unleash a wave of evil spirits that Root the first enemy Hero hit for 2.5 seconds and deal 250 damage to them over the same duration. Durance of Hate spreads outwards from its initial target, Rooting and damaging additional nearby enemy Heroes.

MephistoSkullMissileAbhorredSkull.name: Abhorred Skull
MephistoSkullMissileAbhorredSkull.description: Hitting a Hero with Skull Missile grants 25% Spell Power for 6 seconds. Skull Missile deals 40% more damage to Heroes under 50% Health.

MephistoLordOfHatredHysteria.name: Hysteria
MephistoLordOfHatredHysteria.description: Lord of Hatred also reduces the cooldown of Mephisto's Heroic Ability. Mephisto is healed for 15% of his maximum Health and Mana when he casts his Heroic Ability.

MephistoShardOfHate.name: Shard of Hate
MephistoShardOfHate.description: Basic Attacks hit enemies near the primary target and activate Lord of Hatred against enemy Heroes, reducing Basic Ability cooldowns by 1 second per Hero hit.

MephistoSkullMissileLightningReaction.name: Lightning Reaction
MephistoSkullMissileLightningReaction.description: Skull Missile explodes on contact with Lightning Nova, dealing 120 damage to nearby enemies.

MephistoLightningNovaStaticField.name: Static Field
MephistoLightningNovaStaticField.description: When Lightning Nova's damage bonus reaches 30%, enemy Heroes within its radius take damage equal to 10% of their maximum Health.

MephistoAnimosity.name: Animosity
MephistoAnimosity.description: Increase the duration of Lightning Nova by 1 second and the maximum amount of bonus damage it can deal from 30% to 42%.

MephistoConsumeSoulsConsumedByHatred.name: Consumed by Hatred
MephistoConsumeSoulsConsumedByHatred.description: Consume Souls deals bonus damage equal to 10% of the target's missing Health. If Consume Souls initial cast kills a Hero it will cast 1 additional time.

MephistoDuranceOfHateUnspeakableHorror.name: Unspeakable Horror
MephistoDuranceOfHateUnspeakableHorror.description: Durance of Hate Silences enemies while they are Rooted and for 3 seconds after its Root expires.

MephistoLightningNovaMimic.name: Mimic
MephistoLightningNovaMimic.description: While both Shade of Mephisto and Lightning Nova are active, Lightning Nova also casts from the Shade's location.

MephistoShadeOfMephistoShadeLord.name: Shade Lord
MephistoShadeOfMephistoShadeLord.description: Activate to swap locations with Shade of Mephisto and refresh its duration. Passive: Shade of Mephisto benefits from all of Mephisto's level 7 Talents.
